start_ray_cluster_on_slurm: start a Ray cluster on SLURM by calling RayCluster.start_head_and_workers with resource requirements
start_ray_head_node: start the head node of a Ray cluster on SLURM using RayCluster.start_head with qos and gpu requirements
start_ray_worker_nodes: start an array of worker nodes for a Ray cluster using RayCluster.start_workers with num_workers and requirements
manage_ray_cluster_state: manage Ray cluster state and head node info using RayClusterState to track jobs and rendezvous data
shutdown_ray_cluster: cancel all SLURM jobs and clean up the Ray cluster by calling RayCluster.shutdown
